core.title: Low Profile Sliding Glass Door Finger Pull, RKS-1S
tags: 2-1/8 Inch Diameter Glass Shower Door Pulls

text.description_html:
Sliding Glass Door Finger Pulls

With a 3/8" projection, this low profile finger pull is made for glass door applications like shower doors. Even with such a low profile, it is comfortable to operate with a 7/16" recess with a slight lip for fingers to catch on to. It has a brushed nickel finish.

The 2-1/8" diameter glass door pull is easy to install, with a simple, screw-on design that adjusts to a rage of glass thicknesses. A 1-3/4" hole is required. Available in polished chrome or brushed nickel finishes.

Specifications and Features of the Sliding Glass Door Finger Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Finish: Brushed Nickel
  • Diameter: 2-1/8"
  • Recess Depth: 7/16"
  • Projection: 3/8"
  • Glass Thickness: 5/16" - 1/2"
  • Back-to-back mounting
  • 1-3/4" hole required in glass
  • Package Includes: 2 pulls and 2 rubber gaskets for a tight seal.



**Item Discontinued. Use 2-1/4" Sliding Glass Door Finger Pulls
